draft.subject: Growave — Japan rollout for store-credit loyalty
draft.body:
Hi Growave team,

We’re A-one Road, a Yokohama company supporting commerce technology firms in Japan. We’re contacting Growave about store-credit loyalty programs for Japanese Shopify fashion loyalty teams coordinating retention across seasonal collections.

Japan’s May 2026 labour survey found regular-staff shortages at 34% of surveyed wholesale/retail establishments. For lean fashion teams, structured store-credit workflows can reduce manual reward handling while keeping repeat-purchase offers aligned with collection launches.

We can lead one year of paid Japan market development: identify the entry application, evaluate Japanese buyer requirements, shape local introduction, and develop partner channels. Buyer evidence would guide credit rules, member communication, and operational ownership. Can we help plan and execute Growave’s Japan rollout around this workflow?

https://calendar.app.google/adKEhXC4UWhQXfJp6

Best regards,
Kazuma Tamura
Founder & CEO, A-one Road Co., Ltd. (Yokohama, Japan)
